provenance_note: The isolated gateway served the file-explorer app built into the Kiro Crew checkout (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/file_explorer, website/src/apps/file-explorer), because a gateway that still ships the built-in cannot install a second app under the same name. This repository is the externally packaged copy of that app: the same backend and the same page, ported. PORTING.md lists where the two differ; none of the differences is on screen in these pictures.
data: fictional: a made-up home folder written by capture/demo_tree.py (see data_notes), plus the app's own saved-state key; Files has no API that writes
data_notes: Files is read-only and has no API that creates a file, so the demo folder could not be seeded through the app's own API. capture/demo_tree.py wrote a made-up home folder (a gardener named Sam and a garden-planner project with one git commit, one edited file and one new file) under the system temp directory, and the gateway ran with HOME pointing at it, so the page opens there and no real user name or path appears.
The open tabs and expanded folders were set through the page's own saved-state key (kc:file-explorer:state:v2) before each picture.
Modified times show the capture day: the demo files were written just before the run.
